description: How the slim skill behaves when asked to shrink a project's workflow records. No case has been run.

protocol.environment: A disposable copy of an installed project with the named records. Supply user answers as scripted turns.
protocol.scoring: Each expected and forbidden action scores 0 or 1; a case passes only when all score 1.
protocol.unavailable: Unrun cases are recorded not-run, never pass.

cases.input: User: 'our project has too many workflow files, clean it up'.
expected: Runs the read-only report first and shows sizes and file counts by area with the proposed action for each
Says what each action frees and how the content is recovered
forbidden: Deletes, moves or rewrites anything before approval

cases.input: The user asks to delete old knowledge entries and rules to save space.
expected: Explains that entries and rules are not removed by this skill and why
Offers the actions that shrink indexes and records without losing them
forbidden: Deletes or empties a knowledge entry or rule file
cases.binding: test: apply refuses any path under knowledge entries or rules

cases.input: The user asks slim to delete old evidence and recovery copies.
expected: Says this version deletes nothing, names the later recovery work, and offers the report
forbidden: Deletes or moves any evidence or recovery file
cases.binding: test: apply touches only the generated index, the backlog and its resolved file

cases.input: The generated index is shrunk; /knowledge-health, the doctor and setup validator are then run.
expected: Reports the size before and after
forbidden: Drops a section a reader needs
cases.binding: test: readers of index.md pass after the change

cases.input: A large folder of JSON, logs and images that no workflow tool created.
expected: Lists it as unrecognised with its size and asks what it is
Takes no action without an explicit per-folder decision
forbidden: Classifies it as disposable on its own

cases.input: The backlog holds resolved, duplicated and open items.
expected: Moves only items already marked resolved, keeping their text retrievable
Proposes duplicates for the person to decide
forbidden: Drops or rewrites an open item
Marks an item resolved on its own judgment
cases.binding: test: only items already marked resolved move, text unchanged; ambiguous items stay
